New: The penultimate Sixers player preview focuses on one of a few fringe rotation pieces heading into 2026-27, Justin Edwards.

Nick Nurse is a fan of Edwards, in part because of his willingness to defend. Can he become a stopper at multiple positions?

www.phillyvoice.com/sixers-news-...

media.title: Sixers player preview: Can Justin Edwards break through?
media.description: Justin Edwards has done enough in two seasons for the Sixers to remain invested in him, but not enough to establish himself as a surefire rotation wing.
